title: [Activity Pager] Custom fixed order
line: Activities can be put in any order from System Settings > Activities, and the Activity Pager and Activity Bar show them in that order.
explanation: Activities were always listed by name: kactivitymanagerd had no stored order and plasma-activities' cache sorted by name, so the Activity Pager and Activity Bar could only show them alphabetically. Daryl Bennett's open MRs (kactivitymanagerd!109, plasma-activities!64, plasma-desktop!3185, plasma-workspace!5986) add a stored order, a sort proxy model and up/down plus Sort by Name buttons in the Activities KCM, but on the rig the KCM and Activity Bar never re-sorted after a move, the Activity Pager (not covered by any MR) never followed the order, and removing an activity renumbered the rest by name. On top of the MRs: the proxy invalidates instead of calling sort() again (a no-op with the same column and order), the cache re-sorts and announces the list when the order changes, libtaskmanager's ActivityInfo forwards that to the pager, ties (activities with no stored order yet, as after an upgrade) fall back to name order on both sides, and removal keeps the manual order.

commits.message:
Add a manual sort order for activities

Activities could only be listed by name, so users had no way to put them
in the order they want. The manager now stores a position for every
activity, keeps it when one is added or removed and lets clients move one.

BUG: 370372

Sort activities by their manual order

The activity cache and models always sorted activities by name. They now
follow the order stored by the manager, falling back to the name for
activities without one, and re-sort live when the order changes.

BUG: 370372

kcms/activities: let users reorder activities

There was no way to choose the order of activities, so the pager and the
other activity widgets always showed them by name. The Activities page now
has buttons to move an activity up or down and one to sort them by name.

BUG: 370372

Show activities in their manual order in the activity bar and pager

The activity bar and the pager listed activities by name and never noticed
when their order changed. The activity bar now uses the sorted model, and
the activity info tells the pager when the list of activities changes.

BUG: 370372

patches.diff:
From b1fc8775b75441eac4febde8eedae50b5f9b6006 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 22:46:57 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Show activities in their manual order in the activity bar and
 pager

The activity bar and the pager listed activities by name and never noticed
when their order changed. The activity bar now uses the sorted model, and
the activity info tells the pager when the list of activities changes.

BUG: 370372
---
 applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml | 11 +++++++++--
 libtaskmanager/activityinfo.cpp  |  1 +
 2 files changed, 10 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml b/applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml
index cd66621029..3f0a2ab094 100644
--- a/applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/activitybar/qml/main.qml
@@ -57,10 +57,17 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             listView.keyNavigationEnabled = Plasmoid.location === PlasmaCore.Types.Floating
         }
 
+        Activities.ActivityModel {
+            id: activityModel
+        }
+
         Repeater {
-            model: Activities.ActivityModel {
-                id: activityModel
+            model: Activities.ActivitySortProxyModel {
+                id: kactivitiesProxy
+
+                sourceModel: activityModel
             }
+
             delegate: PlasmaComponents.TabButton {
                 id: tab
 
diff --git a/libtaskmanager/activityinfo.cpp b/libtaskmanager/activityinfo.cpp
index f8c689ce83..18da81a146 100644
--- a/libtaskmanager/activityinfo.cpp
+++ b/libtaskmanager/activityinfo.cpp
@@ -50,6 +50,7 @@ ActivityInfo::ActivityInfo(QObject *parent)
     }
 
     connect(d->activityConsumer, &KActivities::Consumer::currentActivityChanged, this, &ActivityInfo::currentActivityChanged);
+    connect(d->activityConsumer, &KActivities::Consumer::activitiesChanged, this, &ActivityInfo::numberOfRunningActivitiesChanged);
 
     if (!d->activitiesModel) {
         d->activitiesModel = new KActivities::ActivitiesModel();
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master: Activity Pager (left) and Activity Bar (right) always list activities by name: Alpha, Default, Music, Work
With the patches, after a session restart: both follow the chosen order Work, Alpha, Default, Music
Pure master: the Activities settings page has no way to reorder activities
With the patches: Work is moved to the top and Alpha down with the new buttons; the list, the Activity Pager and the Activity Bar update at once
